applicability.rationale: The work crosses authority and equipment-state boundaries and cannot rely on informal prose.

delegated.bounds: May be paper or digital if fields, identities, correction history and transition semantics are preserved.
May use site vocabulary without weakening stop conditions or authority.

fixed.rationale: Silence cannot safely transfer equipment authority.
fixed.statement: Custody changes only through explicit acknowledgement.

fixed.rationale: Maintenance completion is not production authorization.
fixed.statement: Only the authorized operator returns equipment to service after review.

prohibited: Treating technician departure as implicit return.
Allowing status-board color alone to authorize energization.

acceptanceCriteria: No missing acknowledgement can create InService.
Offline execution has a safe path.

artifactTopology.responsibility: Capture equipment identity, state, authorization, isolation and return evidence.
Define ordered actions and stop conditions.
Expose current custody and return-to-service state.

failureAndRecovery: Failed isolation stops before custody transfer.
Disputed return remains out of service and escalates to the equipment owner.
Lost record creates a new linked recovery record; no inferred acknowledgements.
behaviorPaths.name: Normal maintenance handoff

steps.interaction: present equipment and completed isolation record
review return and authorize in-service transition

behaviorPaths.success: Equipment returns to service with unambiguous custody and evidence.

effectBoundaries.authorization: return-reviewed state and site safety authority
effectBoundaries.effect: energize or return equipment to service
effectBoundaries.failure: remain stopped and raise an exception record
effectBoundaries.idempotency: not assumed; verify actual state before action

failureSemantics: Any missing acknowledgement leaves equipment out of service.
invariants: Only one accountable custodian at a time.
InService requires return review and isolation release evidence.
keyContracts.name: MaintenanceCustodyState
keyContracts.responsibility: Prevent ambiguous custody and illegal return.
keyContracts.shape: Requested -> Isolated -> AcceptedByMaintenance -> WorkComplete -> ReturnReviewed -> InService

invariants: Equipment identity is immutable for the record.
keyContracts.name: Maintenance Handoff Record
keyContracts.responsibility: Carry exact handoff meaning and evidence.
keyContracts.shape: equipment ID, state, operator, technician, isolation points, timestamps, exceptions, signatures/receipts

migrationTouchpoints.statement: Pilot may begin on paper, but field identity and transition semantics must match any later digital form.

observabilityPoints.statement: Status board displays current custodian, state and age of the handoff.

stateOwnership.concurrency: parallel work requires named sub-scopes and one final custodian
stateOwnership.consistency: one state transition at a time
stateOwnership.mutationAuthority: current authorized custodian plus transition receipt
stateOwnership.recovery: reconstruct from signed/acknowledged receipts; otherwise remain out of service

testSeams.statement: Run a tabletop walkthrough for normal, missing-acknowledgement and disputed-return scenarios.

subject.purpose: Create a safe, auditable handoff from production operator to maintenance technician and back.

uncertainties.impact: Digital-only acknowledgement could block or encourage bypass.
uncertainties.statement: Some areas have intermittent network access.
